title: Multi-Way Branching with if / else if / else
description: Chain if(age >= 35), else if(age >= 18), and else so Java selects the first matching branch from top to bottom.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Set int age = 21 and check the most restrictive threshold if(age >= 35) first on line 5.
Follow with else if(age >= 18) on line 7 and a final else block on lines 9-11.

steps.question: For age = 21, which condition evaluates to true, and what would happen if we swapped lines 5 and 7 so if(age >= 18) came before else if(age >= 35)?
steps.answer: For age = 21, age >= 35 is false and age >= 18 is true, so line 8 runs. If if(age >= 18) came first, any age >= 35 would also satisfy age >= 18 and take the first branch. That would make else if(age >= 35) unreachable.

steps.description: See age = 21 fail if(age >= 35) on line 5 and match else if(age >= 18) on line 7. It executes line 8 before jumping past else to line 12.
